merges.resolution_basis: Control Center approved Georgia Tech Stage 1 maintenance: current main contains duplicate physical identities for San Diego's Cox Arena/Viejas Arena building. Preserve established VEN-000226 / viejas-arena, whose registry already carries Cox Arena as a historical alias with institutional source basis, and retire later Cincinnati-onboarding duplicate VEN-000677 / cox-arena-at-aztec-bowl. Georgia Tech Research historical meaning is unchanged.
